# StoryChoice

One option in a [StoryNode](StoryNode.md)'s choice menu.

## Parameters

- `label`: A string. Button text.
- `target`: An integer. BehaviorNode index chosen; play continues at that node's first page.
- `condition`: A [StoryCondition](StoryCondition.md) object. Condition gating the option: shown only while it passes. `None` is always shown. Optional.
